name: Slideout
summary: Panel that slides in from the side for side tasks: filters, details, mobile navigation. Content is a native Figma slot.
use: Filters or details next to a list that must stay visible.
avoid: Main tasks: give them their own page.
behaviour: Slides in from the side. Escape, the close button or the backdrop closes it.
a11y: Native <dialog> with showModal: focus goes in and stays in.
After closing, focus goes back to the button that opened it.
content: The title names the task: "Filters", "Project details".
do: Primary action on the right in the footer.
dont: Open a Slideout from a Slideout or a Modal.
